messages:
erin_pm: Heads-up: finance and a handful of customers want a clear 'pin exit' playbook. We need proposal for modes, acceptance gates, and migration incentives. Can we sketch an MVP before next Tues?

chao_eng: From infra: technical gates = p95 <= baseline *1.15, error rate delta <= +0.3% absolute, no new OOMs. We should require perf and mem artifacts for each candidate model.

viv_research: Quality gates: automated eval on 300 prompts + 10-person blind review. Metrics: hallucination rate, instruction-following. Reject if human preference drops >6%.

sam_support: Must include: console opt-out toggle, rollback API, and two templated emails (pre-notice, cutover). Also note: dedicated customers require manual opt-in.

chao_eng: Canary pattern: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated checks at each step and immediate rollback on threshold breach. We'll add route fields: version, weight, abort_conditions.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled for v3.2-q5 (cohort: pilot-batch) - job 2026-05-04-07

erin_pm: Incentives idea: either one-month credit OR 45-day extended pin for assisted migrations. Also carve out white-glove for enterprise (SRE + 2 windows).

viv_research: Timeline: perf sweep 48h, automated evals 24h, human review 48h parallel -> ~72h aggregate for alpha.

erin_pm: OK action list: chao -> perf artifact + canary config (48h), viv -> eval set + human panel plan (72h), sam -> comms + rollback templates (EOD). Reconvene tomorrow 10am PT. Thanks.
